shared_elements: T-shaped monolithic stone pillar with broad rectangular head above a narrower shaft
animal rendered in relief on the pillar shaft
quadruped/predator-like creature with limbs shown against the stone
surrounding rubble/dry-stone walling and excavation debris
justification: The most specific correspondence is the shared object type and layout: a T-shaped monolith whose wide flat head sits on a narrower shaft, with a relief animal placed on the shaft face, both standing in an excavated rubble-walled setting. The biggest difference is density and depth of carving \u2014 A is crowded with a horizontal band of chevron/zigzag pattern, multiple birds, quadrupeds and a snake-like form in shallow flat relief, while B's stone is almost entirely blank apart from a single, much more three-dimensional, high-relief creature.
